objective: Product awareness for CodeLaksh ERP and free-trial sign-ups
audience: Owners of retail shops, distributors, restaurants and hotels in India who bill on paper, Excel or unreliable internet
concept: 4-slide carousel built from real ERP screenshots: offline-first hook, GST invoices, mobile view (Growth plan), 7-day trial CTA
hook: Your billing counter shouldn't stop when the internet does.
caption:
Your billing counter shouldn't stop when the internet does.

CodeLaksh ERP runs fully offline on desktop, so you can keep making GST-ready invoices (CGST / SGST, print, PDF or share) even when the connection drops.

On the Growth plan, cloud sync and the Android app let you check revenue, dues and reports from your phone.

Built in India for shops, distributors, restaurants and hotels:
- GST-ready billing and barcode scanning
- Inventory, purchases and accounting
- 7-day free trial on Starter and Growth

Want to try it? Tap the link in bio or visit codelaksh.in/erp. Growth starts at Rs. 599/month (excludes 18% GST).

What slows your billing counter down the most? Tell us in the comments.
cta: Explore features and start the 7-day free trial
